note: Major, stable funding schemes for study and research. Only facts that hold across cycles are recorded here: who funds it, who may apply, what it covers, and where the authoritative page is. Deadlines move every year, so `cycle` describes the usual window and is never treated as authoritative — the URL is. Verified reachable on 2026-08-03; entries marked blocked return 403 to automated clients but are live in a browser.

schemes.name: Chevening Scholarships
schemes.eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with work experience, returning home for two years after study
schemes.cycle: Usually opens August, closes early November

schemes.name: Commonwealth Scholarships
schemes.eligibility: Citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries; several tracks including split-site PhD
schemes.cycle: Varies by track, most close between October and December

schemes.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
schemes.eligibility: Any nationality outside the UK, applying to Cambridge; highly competitive
schemes.cycle: Two rounds, usually October (US citizens) and early December

schemes.name: Rhodes Scholarship
schemes.eligibility: Citizens of eligible constituencies, applying to Oxford, usually under 24
schemes.cycle: Constituency-dependent, most close between July and October

schemes.name: Clarendon Fund Scholarships
schemes.eligibility: Any nationality, graduate applicants to Oxford; no separate application in most cases
schemes.cycle: Tied to the Oxford course deadline, usually December or January

schemes.name: UKRI funding opportunities
schemes.eligibility: Mostly awarded to institutions and supervisors; studentships are then advertised by universities
schemes.cycle: Rolling, each call has its own deadline

schemes.name: Leverhulme Trust grants and fellowships
schemes.eligibility: Early career fellowships, study abroad studentships, and research project grants
schemes.cycle: Scheme-dependent, several annual rounds

schemes.name: Wellcome research funding
schemes.eligibility: Health, life sciences, and related research; several career-stage schemes
schemes.cycle: Scheme-dependent, rolling

schemes.name: Marie Sklodowska-Curie Doctoral Networks
schemes.eligibility: Any nationality; recruited into funded doctoral networks with a mobility rule
schemes.cycle: Network call usually closes in November; recruitment follows year-round

schemes.name: ERC Starting Grant
schemes.eligibility: Principal investigators 2-7 years after PhD, hosted by a European institution
schemes.cycle: Usually opens July, closes October

schemes.name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal
schemes.eligibility: Every open EU call in one place, including Horizon Europe
schemes.cycle: Rolling

schemes.name: DAAD scholarships
schemes.eligibility: International students and researchers going to Germany; database covers many programmes
schemes.cycle: Programme-dependent, many close between August and December

schemes.name: DAAD RISE Germany
schemes.eligibility: Undergraduates in science and engineering from outside Germany, for a summer research placement
schemes.cycle: Usually opens November, closes December

schemes.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
schemes.funder: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
schemes.eligibility: International students; nominated by the French host institution rather than applying directly
schemes.cycle: Institutions nominate around January

schemes.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
schemes.eligibility: Country-specific quotas; applications go through the Swiss embassy in your country
schemes.cycle: Country-dependent, most close between September and December

schemes.name: EMBO fellowships and grants
schemes.eligibility: Life sciences researchers moving between countries
schemes.cycle: Two rounds a year for postdoctoral fellowships

schemes.name: HFSP Postdoctoral Fellowships
schemes.eligibility: Any nationality, for interdisciplinary life science research with a change of country and field
schemes.cycle: Usually a single annual round closing in May

schemes.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
schemes.eligibility: Non-US citizens; applications run through the Fulbright commission in your own country
schemes.cycle: Country-dependent, most close between February and October

schemes.name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
schemes.eligibility: Any nationality, any Stanford graduate programme; separate application to the university's
schemes.cycle: Usually closes in October

schemes.name: Schwarzman Scholars
schemes.eligibility: Any nationality, for a one-year master's at Tsinghua; under 29
schemes.cycle: Two deadlines, usually May for Chinese applicants and September for everyone else

schemes.name: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship
schemes.eligibility: US citizens, nationals, and permanent residents only
schemes.cycle: Usually closes in October

schemes.name: SMART Scholarship
schemes.eligibility: US citizens in STEM, with a service commitment to a DoD facility
schemes.cycle: Usually opens August, closes December

schemes.name: Mitacs Globalink Research Internship
schemes.eligibility: Undergraduates from partner countries, for a summer research placement in Canada
schemes.cycle: Usually opens July, closes September

schemes.name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
schemes.eligibility: Any nationality, nominated by a Canadian institution
schemes.cycle: Institutional nomination, usually closing in autumn

schemes.name: MEXT Scholarships
schemes.eligibility: International students; embassy or university recommendation routes
schemes.cycle: Embassy route usually opens in spring

schemes.name: Google PhD Fellowship
schemes.eligibility: PhD students nominated by their university, in computing and related fields
schemes.cycle: Region-dependent, nominations usually in spring

schemes.name: Microsoft Research PhD Fellowship
schemes.eligibility: PhD students in computing; regional programmes with their own rules
schemes.cycle: Region-dependent, usually autumn

schemes.name: NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship
schemes.eligibility: PhD students who have completed their first year, in GPU-related research
schemes.cycle: Usually opens August, closes September
